scenes.title: Market Lessons
scenes.summary: At the market, Barinov shows Senya how to read a fish seller's face to tell how many days old the fish really is, and the seller is not amused.

scenes.title: See You at Arcobaleno
scenes.summary: Elena, the chef of the rival restaurant Arcobaleno, runs into Barinov at the market and promises a return visit. Afterwards Barinov suspects Senya of having eaten at Arcobaleno, and Senya denies it.

scenes.title: Debt and Menu
scenes.summary: Victoria demands that Viktor repay his outstanding debt or present a brand-new seasonal chef special by tomorrow.

scenes.title: Discipline in the Hall
scenes.summary: Victoria reprimands the waitstaff for flirting during working hours, before Max tries to invite her out for the evening.

scenes.title: Seasonal menu
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor announces a contest for a seasonal dish. The winner gets a bonus.

scenes.title: Double date
scenes.summary: In the bar, Max introduces Vika to Nastya and Kostya as his girlfriend; they know her only as Victoria Sergeyevna, their boss, and the evening starts awkwardly.

scenes.title: An Unsuccessful Introduction
scenes.summary: Kostya admires the bar while Max brings drinks and tries to get a toast going, but nobody quite relaxes.

scenes.title: Strange Friends
scenes.summary: Max's mojito story falls flat and Vika is plainly annoyed. Nastya needles her about the kissing ban at work, refuses to be ordered about outside work, and drags Kostya home.

scenes.title: The Seasonal Dish
scenes.summary: Barinov tastes the seasonal-dish entries and picks Senya's veal rolls with ham, calling him a cripple before remembering his promise. Fedya is left presenting his Breton lamb chops to an empty room.

scenes.title: Chops with Asparagus
scenes.summary: Fedya announces his Breton lamb chops with asparagus to nobody; this line is taught at the end of the previous scene.

scenes.title: Max's Birthday
scenes.summary: Looking for a way to reconcile his feuding friends and his girlfriend Vika, Max suddenly remembers that tomorrow is his birthday, though he worries nobody will believe a last-minute invitation.

scenes.title: A Trick and a Slicer
scenes.summary: Nagiyev plans a return visit to Arcobaleno with a reluctant Barinov. Senya serves Nagiyev his veal rolls as the chef's new seasonal dish and talks him into buying a slicer before being sent off.

scenes.title: Two Dining Rooms
scenes.summary: At Arcobaleno, the hostess greets Barinov and Nagiyev. Nagiyev mocks the separate dining rooms and the air conditioning, Barinov cuts the jokes short, and they ask for the smoking room.

scenes.title: A Birthday Gift
scenes.summary: At Claude Monet, Kostya and Nastya warmly congratulate Max on his birthday and surprise him with a ticket to DJ Vanderoit's concert so the three friends can party together tonight.

scenes.title: A Ticket to the Club
scenes.summary: While Viktor mocks the rival restaurant's chaotic fusion menu, Vika tells Max she has planned a special holiday dinner for his birthday. When she spots the single club ticket from Kostya and Nastya, Max reassures her that his friends will understand.

scenes.title: A Strict Assessment
scenes.summary: After finishing their meal at the rival restaurant, the hostess asks how they liked the dishes. While his companion praises the food as delicious and nearly as good as theirs, Chef Viktor grudgingly admits that it will do.

scenes.title: Dispute Over the Dish
scenes.summary: Viktor goes to the rival restaurant and accuses the chef of stealing his new dish.

scenes.title: You Are Dead Meat
scenes.summary: Viktor confronts Senya in the kitchen about the stolen recipe.

scenes.title: A Surprise for Everyone
scenes.summary: Vika calls Max, who is waiting outside her apartment with unexpected guests.

scenes.title: An Unsuccessful Holiday
scenes.summary: Max brings Nastya and Kostya to Vika's apartment, but everyone is angry at him.

scenes.title: End of the Conflict
scenes.summary: In the dining room, Nastya and Vika apologise to Max for ruining his birthday. The conflict is settled for now, and Max asks Nastya to bring him a glass.

scenes.title: A Glass for the Chef
scenes.summary: Max finishes his request to Nastya for a glass; the line is taught at the end of the previous scene.

scenes.title: The Secret of the Passport
scenes.summary: Examining Max's passport on the kitchen counter, Chef Viktor notices that his birthday is actually in February, revealing that Max told a well-intentioned lie.

scenes.title: A Clean Slate
scenes.summary: Max reflects in voice-over that one lie breeds another and that a fresh start from a clean slate depends only on yourself.
